required_context_review.description: Approve/reduce must set every required context review flag to true. This mirrors hermes_judgment_audit_report.REQUIRED_CONTEXT_REVIEW_FLAGS.

context_review.description: Required for approve/reduce. Machine-readable checklist proving Hermes reviewed technicals, data health, readiness, portfolio risk, forward evidence, external context, event catalysts, market sentiment, fundamentals context, source reliability, simulation performance, and cron/report wiring before supporting a trade.

market_context.description: Optional snapshot or summary of market_context_report used by Hermes during review.

market_regime_exception.description: Set true only when approving or reducing a new BUY despite risk_off market_context.

market_regime_exception_reason.description: Specific reason for overriding risk_off breadth context. When market_context cross_market.alignment is conflicts_with_breadth, the judgment text must explicitly discuss both breadth and cross-market sentiment/index/VIX evidence. When native_index_context.alignment is conflicts_with_breadth, it must explicitly discuss both stock-pool breadth and native index evidence.

external_market_context_risk_acknowledge.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after reviewing relevant negative external_market_context items.

external_market_context_ids.description: Relevant external_market_context.items[].id values reviewed by Hermes when negative news, macro, capital-flow, event, or sentiment context is present.

external_market_context_notes.description: Specific notes about negative external market context and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold.

external_market_context_support_acknowle.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after using relevant positive high-impact external_market_context items as support.

external_market_context_support_ids.description: Relevant positive external_market_context.items[].id values used by Hermes as support.

external_market_context_support_notes.description: Specific notes about positive external market context and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold.

external_market_context_coverage_acknowl.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that external_market_context coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

external_market_context_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.external_market_context.status when external context coverage acknowledgement is required.

external_market_context_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed news, macro, event, or capital-flow coverage limited confidence or prevented using absence of external items as evidence.

market_context_coverage_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that market_context coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

market_context_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.market_context.status when market context coverage acknowledgement is required.

market_context_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed market regime, breadth, native-index, or cross-market context limited confidence or prevented treating absence of risk_off as benign.

event_catalyst_risk_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after reviewing relevant negative event_catalysts.

event_catalyst_ids.description: Relevant event_catalysts.candidates[].id values reviewed by Hermes.

event_catalyst_signal_ids.description: Relevant event_catalyst_signals.signals[].signal_id values reviewed by Hermes, especially CHALLENGE_BUY_REVIEW signals related to the BUY.

event_catalyst_risk_notes.description: Event-specific risk notes for negative watchlist-linked catalysts.

event_catalyst_coverage_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that event_catalysts coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

event_catalyst_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.event_catalysts.status when event catalyst coverage acknowledgement is required.

event_catalyst_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed event-catalyst coverage limited confidence or prevented using absence of event catalysts as evidence.

event_catalyst_signal_coverage_acknowled.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that event_catalyst_signals coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

event_catalyst_signal_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.event_catalyst_signals.status when event signal coverage acknowledgement is required.

event_catalyst_signal_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed event-signal coverage limited confidence or prevented using absence of event signals as evidence.

event_catalyst_support_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after using relevant SUPPORT_BUY_REVIEW event_catalyst_signals as support.

event_catalyst_support_signal_ids.description: Relevant event_catalyst_signals.signals[].signal_id values reviewed by Hermes as positive BUY support.

event_catalyst_support_notes.description: Specific notes about positive event-catalyst support and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold without overriding gates.

fundamentals_context_limit_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after reviewing partial/fallback fundamentals context, such as Tencent quote snapshots with missing PB, PS, ROE, growth, dividend, market cap, or leverage fields.

fundamentals_context_symbols.description: Symbols whose partial/fallback fundamentals were reviewed before approve/reduce.

fundamentals_context_missing_metrics.description: Missing fundamentals metrics Hermes explicitly considered before approve/reduce.

fundamentals_context_notes.description: Specific notes about partial/fallback fundamentals coverage and how it affected confidence, sizing, or rejection.

fundamentals_context_coverage_acknowledg.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that fundamentals_context coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

fundamentals_context_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.fundamentals_context.status when fundamentals coverage acknowledgement is required.

fundamentals_context_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed valuation, profitability, growth, dividend, or leverage coverage limited confidence or prevented treating absence of fundamentals as neutral.

fundamentals_context_support_acknowledge.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after using full, fresh fundamentals context as support.

fundamentals_context_support_symbols.description: Symbols whose full/fresh fundamentals were used as positive support.

fundamentals_context_support_metrics.description: Specific valuation, profitability, growth, dividend, or leverage metrics Hermes used as support.

fundamentals_context_support_notes.description: Specific notes about full/fresh fundamentals support and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold without overriding gates.

market_sentiment_risk_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after reviewing relevant risk_off or negative market_sentiment indicators.

market_sentiment_indicator_ids.description: Relevant market_sentiment.indicators[].id values reviewed by Hermes when sentiment risk is present.

market_sentiment_notes.description: Specific notes about quantified risk-off or negative sentiment and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold.

market_sentiment_coverage_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing that market_sentiment coverage is missing, stale, failed, or invalid.

market_sentiment_coverage_status.description: Reviewed context_digest.market_sentiment.status when market sentiment coverage acknowledgement is required.

market_sentiment_coverage_notes.description: Notes explaining how missing/stale/failed volatility, capital-flow, or risk-appetite coverage limited confidence or prevented using absence of sentiment indicators as evidence.

market_sentiment_support_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a BUY after using relevant risk_on or positive market_sentiment indicators as support.

market_sentiment_support_indicator_ids.description: Relevant market_sentiment.indicators[].id values used by Hermes as positive support.

market_sentiment_support_notes.description: Specific notes about quantified risk-on or positive market sentiment and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold without overriding gates.

source_reliability_limit_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing while source_reliability.status is DEGRADED, STALE, MISSING, or FAIL.

source_reliability_components.description: source_reliability.components[].name values whose degraded, stale, missing, or failed status was reviewed.

source_reliability_reasons.description: source_reliability component reasons or report recommendations Hermes considered before approve/reduce.

source_reliability_notes.description: Specific notes about source-quality limits and how they affected confidence, sizing, or rejection.

simulation_performance_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing while simulation_performance.status is WARN or FAIL.

simulation_performance_status.description: Reviewed top-level simulation_performance.status when simulation performance is WARN or FAIL.

simulation_performance_reason_codes.description: simulation_performance.reason_codes values Hermes considered before approve/reduce.

simulation_performance_notes.description: Specific notes about weak realized simulation performance, remediation hash, or portfolio risk and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold.

hermes_alpha_evidence_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing while strategy_learning_brief.hermes_alpha_evidence.status is INSUFFICIENT, NEGATIVE, MISSING, or INVALID, or when the evidence object is absent.

hermes_alpha_evidence_status.description: Reviewed strategy_learning_brief.hermes_alpha_evidence.status when weak or missing alpha evidence acknowledgement is required.

hermes_alpha_evidence_notes.description: Specific notes explaining why Hermes is approving/reducing even though audit-pass approval alpha is unproven or negative.

intraday_context_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing a signal whose context_digest.required_judgment_attention includes intraday context missing/stale, contradiction, market-session, calendar-override, minute-producer, or minute-quality notes.

intraday_context_status.description: The reviewed review_items[].context_digest.intraday_context.status value, when intraday context required explicit discussion.

intraday_context_notes.description: Specific notes about same-session intraday confirmation, contradiction, missing/stale minute coverage, producer/apply/source limits, market-session state, calendar-override limits, or degraded minute-bar quality and how it affected confidence, sizing, rejection, or hold.

intraday_signal_evidence_acknowledged.description: Set true when approving or reducing after reviewing context_digest.intraday_signal_evidence.requires_judgment_acknowledgement=true.

intraday_signal_evidence_alignment.description: Copy of context_digest.intraday_signal_evidence.alignment when intraday signal evidence requires acknowledgement.

intraday_signal_evidence_codes.description: Reviewed context_digest.intraday_signal_evidence.codes[] values, covering support, challenge, conflict, quality, or source-limit evidence.

intraday_signal_evidence_notes.description: Specific notes explaining whether 5m/15m/30m/60m/session evidence supported, challenged, conflicted with, or was too low-quality to strengthen the judgment.

strategy_evidence.description: Optional snapshot or summary of rt_signal_outcome_report used by Hermes during review.
